headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low despite high macro and geopolitical Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend, so there is no fresh continuation, retracement, or session-extreme evidence. Friday ended with the Nasdaq down 0.52% after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight; Iran separately said Hormuz restrictions would continue. Those factors sustain Stress, but not a currently observed pathological price path.
